title: Research Paper Summarizer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Extracts findings, methods, and conclusions from research papers. The Research Paper Summarizer extracts findings, methods, and conclusions from papers. It reads the full text and produces a structured brief: research question, method, key results with numbers, limitations, and conclusion. The summary stays faithful to the paper and always links each claim back to the section it came from.
capabilities: Extract research question, method, and results
Pull key numbers and effect sizes
Note limitations and sample details
Link each claim to its paper section
Produce a structured one-page brief

demo.title: Core operation executed
demo.code: const docs=[{id:1,text:'spaced repetition improves recall'},{id:2,text:'massed practice is weaker'},{id:3,text:'sleep aids memory'}];const hits=docs.filter(d=>d.text.includes('repetition')).map(d=>d.id);J({hits});assert(JSON.stringify(hits)==='[1]','search');

demo.title: Worked example end to end
demo.code: const paras=['Sleep consolidates memory.','REM sleep aids procedural learning.','Naps improve afternoon recall.'];const brief=paras.map(p=>p.split('.')[0]+'.');J({sentences:brief.length,first:brief[0]});assert(brief.length===3&&brief[0]==='Sleep consolidates memory.','summarize');
